title: Sportswear HO19 / Zoom 2K landscape collage

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Sportswear Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Connect a product close-up with a human scene so a viewer can understand both its appearance and its place in everyday life.
strategic_value: The taped portrait and oversized shoe can make a retro product story feel personal rather than purely technical.
demonstration: A taped portrait at left overlaps colored textures and smaller photographs; a large shoe crop fills the right, with a white headline spanning the lower middle.
practical_value: Compare the space given to identity, wearer and shoe when adapting a campaign to a wide format.

content_islands.name: Portrait collage
content_islands.spec: Place the framed portrait at left over smaller photographic fragments and a coral texture.

content_islands.name: Product crop
content_islands.spec: Fill the right side with the shoe and lower leg, letting the footwear dominate the foreground.

content_islands.name: Copy and signature
content_islands.spec: Place the wide white headline across the lower middle, followed by smaller copy and the Nike signature.

reference_purposes.Expression: A taped portrait at left overlaps colored textures and smaller photographs; a large shoe crop fills the right, with a white headline spanning the lower middle.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying designer account explains that the layouts reconcile existing imagery, different retail formats and digital crops into a consistent campaign.
